Game Overview

Pocket Zone puts players into a adventure experience centered on explore the eerie remnants of Chernobyl, navigating a treacherous world where your choices shape unique events. Survive amidst a hazardous environment with a detailed mining system. Arm yourself from a vast arsenal, and face the unknown challenges lurking in this immersive survival adventure. Can you fulfill your innermost dream?
